lanes.semantic_interpretation: All lanes must proceed straight ahead onto the road segment indicated by the sign and the road ahead is restricted to 30 mph or km/h (implied by the circular sign). The sign itself is a speed limit sign, not a lane direction sign, but it governs the movement of the lanes shown.

result.overall_lane_semantics: The visible lanes are restricted to moving straight ahead with a speed limit of 30.
